summary: Compiles the issues found with the Stream Control Transmission Protocol since RFC 4960 was published in 2007, together with suggested fixes. It is organized in time order as a list of changes to that text. It is informational and was replaced by RFC 9260.

eli5.summary: A list of mistakes and unclear spots people found in an older rulebook for a data delivery system, along with fixes, written down in the order they were found.
